column2: Crush a rival
My rival has crossed me for the last time. I will see them in the grave or in my dungeon.
Your rival dies, or rots in your dungeon
Slay a great beast
Somewhere in the wilds a beast grows fat on cattle and men. I will be the one who brings back its head.
Kill a great beast in a hunt
Atone for my sins
My sins weigh on me, and the gods see them all. I will do penance until one of them is gone.
Rid yourself of one of the sins you hold today
Become a Knight
My father was a Knight of the Realm, and his father before him. I will earn my spurs and swear the vow.
Drink from the Grail
The Lady has shown herself to me in dreams. I will seek her Grail, and drink, or die in the seeking.
Ride with the Great Pulk
The north stirs again. When the Great Pulk rides out, I will ride at its head and break the Chaos host.
Lead an army to victory against a Chaos army
Chart Lustria
The maps end at the edge of the jungle. I will take my house beyond them.
Hold a county in Lustria, or return from a Lustrian expedition
Strike out a grudge
The Book of Grudges is long, and my name is written in it beside too many wrongs left unpaid. One of them will be struck out.
Settle a grudge
Earn a rune
The runesmiths keep their best work for those who earn it. I will carry a rune into battle.
Get da best choppa
Da best boyz 'ave da best choppas. I want da best choppa.
Find da Shiny
Shiny fings! Lots of shiny fings! Mine, all mine!
Sneak a good stab
Da big 'uns fink dey're safe. Nobody's safe from a good stab in da back.
One of your murder plots succeeds
Feed the Great Maw
The Maw is always hungry, and the Maw is in my belly. I will grow it until it can hold a mountain.
Catch a Stonehorn
The Stonehorn is the biggest beast of the mountains. I will catch one and ride it.
Kill an important man-thing
The man-things think their crowns keep them safe. Clan Eshin will teach them otherwise. Quick-quick, quiet-quiet.
Have a king or emperor murdered
Shed a virtue for Slaanesh
The Prince of Pleasure frowns on restraint. I will cast off one of my chains to please him.
Shed a virtue for Khorne
The Blood God has no use for mercy, patience or fear. One of them must be cut out of me.
Shed a virtue for Nurgle
Grandfather Nurgle loves those who enjoy his gifts. I must stop denying myself.
Shed a virtue for Tzeentch
The Changer of Ways despises the honest and the content. I will change.
Skulls for the Skull Throne
Khorne cares not from where the blood flows, but he wants the skulls. I will take five for his Throne.
Embrace rot
Grandfather Nurgle's gift is the greatest of all. I will take it gladly and live with it a year.
Catch the Rot and live with it for a year
Weave the great scheme
Every thread in the Great Weave leads to Tzeentch. I will pull a few of them myself.
Two of your murder plots succeed
Master the change
The Changer of Ways rewards those who change. Let him change me.
Win the eye of the gods
The gods are watching. I will give them a reason to reward me.
Receive a gift of the Dark Gods
Rise as a Chaos Champion
Many warriors follow the Dark Gods. Few are chosen as champions. I will be one of the few.
Prove yourself in the hunt
A daughter of the Amazons is not a warrior until she has won the hunt. I will win it.
Make a pilgrimage
The holy city calls the faithful once in their lives. It is time I answered.
Come home from the great pilgrimage
Win the Dragon Emperor's favour
The Dragon Emperor sees all from his throne in Wei-Jin. I will earn his grace.
Gather the lost lore
Nagash wrote down secrets that the Necrarchs have spent ages hunting. I will add to what we know.
Guard the Shrine of Asuryan
The Phoenix Guard stand silent watch over the Flame of Asuryan. I would stand among them.
Find the Fountain of Youth
Somewhere in the jungle of Lustria a pool gives back the years. I will find it.
Find the Pools of the Fountain of Youth
Cast off one of the virtues your god despises
Lead an army or a flank to victory in battle
Lead others in battle
I have studied war long enough. Give me men and a field, and I will show my liege what I can do.
Hold the court office you asked for
Fill a court office
The court has an empty seat that I was made for. I will ask for it.
Come home from your training
Train abroad
The masters of my craft do not live at this court. Let me go to them, and I will come back worth twice what I am now.
Come home alive from the wars abroad
Seek glory abroad
There is nothing for a sword to do at this court. Somewhere a war is being fought, and I mean to be in it.
Become a friend of your liege
Win the ruler's friendship
My liege is lonely at the top of the hall. I could change that.
The killer of your kin is dead or in chains
Avenge my kin
My blood was spilled and the hand that did it still feasts. I will not rest while it does.
Be kept at court on your own terms, or leave for a greater one
Serve a great house
My talents are wasted on this little court. Either my liege shows what I am worth, or a greater lord will.
Own 200 gold
Make a fortune
A little gold, put to work in the right hands, becomes a lot of gold. My hands are the right ones.
Krump your boss in a fight
Krump da boss
Da boss is gettin' old an' soft. Time somebody bigger 'ad 'is job. Me.
Have another Skaven murdered
Climb over others
Every rat above me is a rung on the ladder. Yes-yes. Climb, climb.
Your capital has a keep of level 3 or higher
Raise the keep
A lord is judged by his walls. Mine will be judged well.
Every province you hold yourself has a level 2 wall or a fort
Secure the borders
Raiders, beasts and worse come over the border every year. Let them find stone when they do.
Win a war you started against a count or greater
Take more land
My lands end where my neighbour's begin. That can be changed.
Build a new temple holding in your lands
Build a temple
The gods have given my house much. It is time I gave something back, in stone.
Build a fort
Raise a border fort
Every border needs a place where the line holds. I will build one.
A fort in your lands has a pirate hideout
Found a pirate hideout
Every captain on this coast needs a cove where no one asks questions. Mine will be the one they pay for.
Build a hospital
Endow a hospital
The sick lie in the streets of my towns. A house of healing, with my name over the door, would change that.
Create a duchy in the Border Princes
Found a principality
In the Border Princes a man is a prince if he can hold what he claims. I mean to claim a principality.
Win a battle against the beastmen
Hunt Beastmen
The herds grow bold in the deep woods. I will take the fight to them before they bring it to my villages.
Build a new stanitsa in your lands
Raise a stanitsa
Where the steppe has no walls, Kislev puts men. A stanitsa of riders on my border will hold it better than stone.
Win a war you started against a lord who is not Tilean
Win a condotta
Tilea fights for gold, and fights well. Let the next war pay for itself, and more.
Build a new silver mine or deep mine in your lands
Open a new mine
Our fathers dug deep. Our sons will dig deeper, and the vein I open will feed the hold for an age.
Win three slaver raids
Fill the slave pits
The furnaces of Hashut eat slaves faster than the pits can be filled. I will fill them.
Your capital has the biggest greenskin fort
Raise a big fort
Da biggest boss needs da biggest fort. Get stackin', ya gits.
Loot a holding of the Dawi
Loot a stunty hold
Da stunties sit on more shiny than dey can carry. Let's 'elp 'em.
Eat a captive king or emperor
Eat a king
A king tastes of rich food and good wine. The Maw has told me so, and I mean to find out.
Win three battles outside your own realm
Hire out the tribe
Men fight for kings. Ogres fight for meat and gold, and the little people pay well.
Have another Skaven ruler murdered
Betray a rival clan
The other clans scheme against me. I will scheme first-faster.
Hold three deep warpstone mines in your realm, or a warpstone cluster
Hoard warpstone
Warpstone is power. Power is mine-mine. More warpstone, more!
Build the top warp refinery or warpstone generators
Build a doom engine
The Warlock-Engineers will build me a wonder of death. Yes-yes, a great machine. It will only kill some of them.
An outbreak starts in the realm of a ruler you are at war with
Brew a new plague
The Horned Rat whispers of a new sickness. I will brew it, and loose it on my foes.
Lead an army to victory in battle
Shed blood
Blood for the Blood God. Skulls for the Skull Throne. The rest is talk.
Five outbreaks start in other realms that border yours or fight you
Spread the Grandfather's gift
Grandfather Nurgle loves all his children, even those who do not know him yet. Let them learn.
Loot three holdings in the Empire or Bretonnia
Raid the southlands
The soft southerners pile their gold in stone houses by the sea. The longships are ready.
Raise a new herdstone in a forest
Raise a herdstone
The Dark Gods want a stone in the deep wood, red with the blood of the herd's foes.
Learn the Lore of Necromancy, or raise the dead
Raise the Restless Dead
The graves of this land are full, and the dead do not rest well. I will teach them to march.
Rule a land of living men, with three living human vassals, while your nature stays hidden
Take a mortal throne
The living kneel to me and never guess what I am. Let them kneel a while longer.
Your capital has the royal tombs or a level 3 tomb
Wake the legion
My legions sleep beneath the sand. The tombs must be made ready, and then they will wake.
Build a level 5 tomb or a grand necropolis
Restore a necropolis
The city of the dead has fallen to ruin while the living squabbled. I will make it as it was.
Build an Imperial dockyard of level 2
Sail with the fleet of Lothern
The Sea Guard of Lothern rules the waves. My ships will sail beside theirs.
Win three slave raids, or build a slave market
Take a thousand slaves
A Druchii lord is measured by the chains he holds. I mean to hold a thousand.
Win a war fought in defence of Athel Loren
Drive out the intruders
They came into the wood with axes and fire. The wood will not let them leave.
Win a war against a follower of Chaos or the Horned Rat
Serve the Great Plan
The Old Ones laid down the Plan. The servants of Chaos and the ratmen stand in its way. They will be removed.
Hold a great feast with five vassals at your table
Host a great feast
Nobody remembers a lean year. Everybody remembers a good feast. Mine will be remembered for generations.
Keep the peace for five years while the warrens grow
Breed the warrens
More rats, more tunnels, more slaves. The warrens must grow-grow, and nothing must stop them.
Control every county of the duchy your capital lies in
Unite the duchy
The duchy is mine by right, but not yet by deed. Every county in it will fly my banner.
Every one of your vassals likes you (opinion 50 or more)
Hold the loyalty of my vassals
A lord with loyal vassals sleeps soundly. I mean to sleep very soundly indeed.
Rule an independent realm
Claim independence
I bend the knee to a lord who could not hold my lands without me. That will end.
A child of yours rules land as the founder of a new house
Found a cadet branch
My house is great enough to put out branches. One of my sons will found his own line.
Hold one of the electorates of the Empire
Become an Elector Count
Only a handful of lords choose the Emperor. I mean to be one of them.
Hold one of the fourteen dukedoms of Bretonnia
Rule as a Duke of Bretonnia
Fourteen dukes sit beneath the King of Bretonnia. By the Lady, I will be one of them.
Your capital has a great library
Found a library
Knowledge is the one treasure that grows when it is shared. My house will keep a great store of it.
Own a trade post, or a market in your lands
Open a trade route
Gold follows the roads. Let it follow one through my lands.
Build a new castle or city
Settle the wilds
Empty land is wasted land. I will raise walls and markets where now there are only wolves.
Hold Black Fire Pass and win a defensive war
Hold Black Fire Pass
Sigmar held the Pass against the greenskin hordes. Let it be said that I held it too.
Own three ports and win a battle at sea
Brave the Sea of Claws
The Sea of Claws eats ships and men. I will cross it, and make it mine.
Own or loot a temple-city of the Old Ones
Find a temple-city
Somewhere in the jungles of Lustria stand cities of gold, older than men. I will find one.
Your realm holds three counties in the Dark Lands
Explore the Dark Lands
Beyond the mountains lies a land of ash and slavers. Few who go there come back. I will go, and stay.
Win an Errantry War
Win an Errantry War
The Lady calls her knights to war. When the Errantry is won, my banner will be among the first in the field.
Break a Spring Driving of the northern tribes
Drive back a Spring Driving
Every spring the tribes come south with the thaw. This spring they will find me waiting.
Hold Praag or Erengrad when a Black Crusade fails
Hold the bulwark
Praag and Erengrad are the gates of the world. While I hold them, the Wastes will not pass.
Own five trade posts
Become a merchant prince
Kings have crowns. Merchant princes have the gold that pays for them.
Win a war against a lord of Araby
Conquer for Myrmidia
The sultans of Araby once held Estalia in chains. Myrmidia demands that the debt be paid.
Your realm has three finished stretches of the Underway
Clear the Underway
The Ungdrin Ankor once joined every hold. Let it be cleared again, league by league.
Build a Fane of Hashut
Build a great furnace
Hashut hungers for fire. I will raise him a furnace that never cools.
Become a Waaagh! warlord, or lead a Waaagh!
Call a Waaagh!
Da boyz is gettin' bored. Time for a proper Waaagh!
Five greenskin chiefs are your vassals
Bring da tribes togevva
All dem little tribes, fightin' each uvva. Dey should be fightin' for me.
Win a war against a human ruler
Beat da 'umies
Da 'umies fink dey're tough. Let's show 'em wot tough is.
Rule five provinces of Ogre culture
Become a Tyrant
A Tyrant is the biggest and the hungriest. Let the other bulls feed at my table.
Three provinces of your realm have thick tunnels or warp roads
Dig the tunnels
Under every city, a tunnel. Under every tunnel, another. Dig-dig!
Take three lovers from other realms
Seduce a rival's court
The Prince of Pleasure loves a stolen heart best. I will steal several.
Raise the Blasphemous Icon to its height: a mountain of skulls
Build a skull pile
Khorne cares not from where the blood flows, but he likes to see the skulls. I will build him a mountain of them.
Three provinces of your realm bloom with Nurgle's gifts
Tend the Garden
Grandfather's Garden must grow in this world too. I will plant it, province by province.
Loot three holdings of human lords
Raze the cities of men
The men cut down the forest to build their stone nests. We will tear the nests down.
Complete the rite before the Great Herdstone
Hold a Greatfray
All the herds must gather at the Great Herdstone and see who is strongest. It will be me.
Turn a mortal into a vampire of your blood
Sire a get
Eternity is long, and lonely. I will make a child of the night to share it.
Three of your seductresses hold their marks in their power
Seduce the royal courts
Kings think they rule. They do not know who whispers in their ears at night. My sisters do.
Hold the Black Grail
Raise a black grail court
The Lady of Bretonnia has her Grail. Mousillon has another, black and full.
Hold a county outside Ulthuan yourself
Hold a colony in the Old World
Ulthuan once had colonies on every shore. It is time the Asur returned to them.
Sit on the Witch King's council
Rise in Naggarond
In Naggarond the Witch King listens to a few. Those he does not listen to die. I mean to be heard.
Win a war in spring, while the Wild Hunt rides
Walk the Wild Hunt
When Orion wakes, the hunt rides. Those who ride with him and live are honoured above all.
Raise a new temple-city
Rebuild a temple-city
The Old Ones raised cities that touched the stars. The Plan demands that we raise them again.
Wake a sleeping slann of your realm
Wake a slann
A Mage-Priest sleeps in the temple, dreaming of the Plan. The skink priests say he may be woken. They are rarely wrong.
Rule a kingdom of Araby as its Sultan
Become a Sultan
The desert has known many sultans. It will know me.
Control all of Albion while the mists hold
Deepen the mist on Albion
The mist hides Albion from the world. When all of it is ours, the mist will never lift.
Raise the crown's authority one step above where it stands today
Raise the crown's authority
My vassals treat the crown as a hat they lend me. They will learn otherwise.
Win a war you started against a duke or greater
Win a war of conquest
A kingdom that does not grow is a kingdom that is dying. Mine will grow.
A rival of royal rank becomes your vassal or pays you tribute
Bring a rival king to heel
Two crowns cannot share one sky. My rival will kneel, or pay to stand.
Hold an emperor-tier title
Claim an empire
Kings are many. Emperors are few. I mean to be one of the few.
Three forts of your realm have watchtowers
Raise a watch line
A line of towers from one border to the other, each in sight of the next. Nothing will cross unseen.
A hospital of your realm has its third building
Raise a great hospital
One house of healing is a kindness. A great hospital is a legacy.
Your realm has a university, a College of Magic or a grand library
Found a university or college
The wise come to the court that feeds them. I will build a house of learning that draws the best minds of the age.
Gain a new artifact of great quality
Commission a masterwork
A king should own one thing that will outlast his line. I will have it made, or take it.
Found a colony across the sea
Found a colony
Beyond the Great Ocean lie lands no lord of mine has ever seen. My banner will fly there.
Refound a realm of the Border Princes
Unite the Border Princes
A hundred princes squabble over a land that could be one realm. Let it be mine.
Form the Union of the Old Peoples
Union of the Old Peoples
Before the Gospodars came, the steppe belonged to the old peoples. It can again.
Hold the throne of Bretonnia
Wear the crown of Bretonnia
The Lady chose Gilles to unite the realm. She will choose me to rule it.
Mousillon is held by you or a living vassal of the Lady
Cleanse Mousillon
The Cursed Duchy is a wound in the realm. I will burn it clean.
Hold the throne of Kislev
Wear the Frost Crown
The Frost Crown waits for one strong enough to wear it. The steppe needs a Tsar.
Hold Karak Eight Peaks, Karak Varn, Mount Gunbad, Karak Azgal or Karak Ungor
Reclaim a lost hold
The Book of Grudges is heavy with the names of lost holds. I will strike one of them out.
Become High King of the Karaz Ankor
Wear the Dragon Crown
The throne of Karaz-a-Karak is the oldest in the world. I will sit on it.
Hold Zharr-Naggrund
Raise the Tower of Zharr
The great ziggurat of Zharr-Naggrund is the seat of the Sorcerer-Prophets. It should be my seat.
Control all of Karak Eight Peaks
Take Eight Peaks
Eight Peaks is da biggest stunty hold dere is. Should be da biggest greenskin hold.
Hold the Mountains of Mourn
Feast at the Great Maw
The Great Maw lies in the Mountains of Mourn. Whoever rules there eats first.
Become a daemon prince
Ascend to Daemonhood
Mortality is a cage. The gods hold the key. I will earn it.
Have five Norscan vassals and win a war against a lord of the Empire
Lead the tribes south
The tribes are many, the south is rich. Together we will take it.
Hold the kingdom of Sylvania
Raise Sylvania
Vlad ruled Sylvania once. The blood of the Carsteins will rule it again.
Hold the empire of Nehekhara
Restore Nehekhara
Nehekhara was the greatest empire of men. It will be again, with its kings risen from the tombs.
Become Phoenix King
Wear the Phoenix Crown
Those who pass through the flame of Asuryan and live are kings of all the Asur.
Ariel and Orion both think highly of you (opinion 75 or more)
Win the favour of Orion and Ariel
The King and Queen in the Woods are the heart of Athel Loren. Their favour is worth more than any crown.
Win a war against another emperor
Humble a rival emperor
There is room for only one emperor under heaven. The other will learn it.
Pass the highest law of imperial administration
Paragon of law
An empire held by the sword falls to the next sword. One held by law endures.
Control every province of the Empire
Unite the Empire
Sigmar forged one Empire from many tribes. It has broken apart since. I will forge it again.
A Black Crusade against your realm fails
Break the Black Crusade
The Everchosen gathers the north to drown the Empire. Let him come, and break on our walls.
Sylvania is held by you or by a vassal who is no vampire
Bring Sylvania to heel
Sylvania is a nest of the dead. It will answer to the Emperor, and to the living.
Beat three kings in war
Make a Great Waaagh!
A proper Great Waaagh! dat da whole world 'ears about. Dat's wot Gork an' Mork want.
Loot or hold three of Altdorf, Couronne, Kislev, Middenheim and Nuln
Bring the Great Ascendancy
The Horned Rat promised us the surface world. The great man-cities will fall first, yes-yes.
Become the Everchosen of Chaos
Become the Everchosen
One mortal is chosen by all four gods to end the world. It will be me.
The doom of the world rises one stage
See the Winds of Chaos rise
The winds of magic blow stronger from the north each year. I will see them become a storm.
The doom of the world falls one stage
See the Winds of Chaos fall
The north grows bolder every year. If the world is to see another century, the tide must turn in my reign.
Win a war against the Witch King
Avenge the Sundering
Malekith broke our people and sank half our land. It is past time he paid.
Hold the throne of Ulthuan
Reclaim Ulthuan
Ulthuan is ours by right. The usurpers on the Phoenix Throne will be cast down.
Win a war against a king who follows Nagash
Destroy the Great Betrayers
Nagash and his get damned Nehekhara to undeath. The kings of the dead will have their vengeance.
the Prince
Founder of a House of Healing
This character endowed a house of healing, and the sick bless the name over its door.
Sometimes a small raider fleet joins you, once in a lifetime
A band of veterans musters at your capital
A learned scholar comes to your court
Two settlers from the colony join your court
